wallet-keystone-description: Keystone is an open-source hardware wallet launched in 2017. It pairs with software wallets such as MetaMask and Rabby to sign transactions offline.
wallet-loopring-wallet-description: Loopring Wallet is a smart contract wallet built on Loopring's zkRollup layer 2, with low-cost trading, transfers and NFTs.
wallet-railway-wallet-description: Railway Wallet is a privacy-focused wallet that integrates the Railgun protocol on Ethereum and other EVM chains, for private transfers and private access to DeFi.
wallet-ready-wallet-description: Ready, formerly Argent, is a self-custodial smart account wallet for Starknet. It uses guardians for account recovery instead of a seed phrase and runs on mobile and in the browser.
wallet-coinbase-wallet-description: Coinbase Wallet is a self-custody wallet for EVM networks and layer 2s, with NFT support, available as a browser extension and as iOS and Android apps.
wallet-frame-description: Frame is a privacy-focused Ethereum wallet that runs natively on macOS, Windows and Linux.
wallet-metamask-description: MetaMask is a self-custody wallet available as a browser extension and mobile app, used to hold assets and connect to Ethereum applications.
wallet-safe-description: Safe is an open-source smart account wallet that requires a set number of signers to approve a transaction before it runs. Individuals, teams and DAOs use it to secure assets on Ethereum and other EVM networks.
wallet-coin-wallet-description: Coin Wallet is a non-custodial multicurrency wallet for multiple platforms.
wallet-ambire-description: Ambire is a self-custody wallet for Ethereum and layer 2 networks that supports EIP-7702 and EIP-4337 smart account features for sending, trading and using apps.
wallet-imtoken-description: imToken is a multi-chain wallet for Ethereum, Bitcoin, Cosmos and other networks, with access to DeFi protocols and layer 2 networks such as Arbitrum.
wallet-iofinnet-mpc-wallet-for-business-: io.finnet is an MPC self-custody wallet for businesses. Signing power is split between team members so there is no single point of failure, with mobile signing and multi-chain support.
wallet-1inch-wallet-description: 1inch Wallet is a non-custodial DeFi wallet for multiple networks, with biometric authentication, encrypted backup, and scam protection that simulates transactions before you sign.
wallet-foxwallet-description: FoxWallet is a self-custody wallet that connects to Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, TRON, Cosmos and other networks.
wallet-pillarx-description: PillarX is an open-source wallet from the Pillar team that uses EIP-7702 to add smart account features, such as batched transactions, to a regular Ethereum account.
wallet-mew-wallet-description: MEW wallet is an Ethereum and DeFi wallet for iOS and Android with layer 2 support. Buy, hold and trade ETH and tokens, and explore Ethereum apps.
wallet-unstoppable-wallet-description: Unstoppable is an open-source, non-custodial multi-wallet for Ethereum, Bitcoin, Polygon and other chains, with a built-in decentralized exchange and analytics for tokens and NFTs.
wallet-alphawallet-description: AlphaWallet is an open-source, self-custodial multi-chain wallet that projects can customize for their own tokens.
wallet-bridge-wallet-description: Bridge Wallet is a wallet for buying, swapping and selling Bitcoin and Ethereum assets while keeping full control of them.
wallet-tokenpocket-description: TokenPocket is a multi-chain wallet for buying, storing, sending and swapping tokens and collecting NFTs.
wallet-rainbow-description: Rainbow is an Ethereum wallet for buying, managing and displaying tokens and NFTs, designed to be simple for people getting started with crypto.
wallet-trezor-description: Trezor is an open-source hardware wallet for managing, trading and staking crypto. Use it with the Trezor Suite app or pair it with software wallets such as MetaMask, Rabby or Rainbow.
wallet-ledger-description: Ledger makes hardware wallets that keep your private keys offline, used with the Ledger Live app or with software wallets.
wallet-exodus-description: Exodus is a desktop, mobile and browser wallet for sending, receiving and exchanging ETH and many other cryptocurrencies, which also works with Trezor hardware wallets.
wallet-rabby-wallet-description: Rabby is a wallet for Ethereum and EVM chains that shows a preview of what each transaction will do before you sign it.
wallet-zerion-wallet-description: Zerion is a wallet for everything onchain, from tokens and NFTs to staked assets and DeFi positions.
wallet-enkrypt-description: Enkrypt is a non-custodial, open-source browser extension wallet from the team behind MyEtherWallet. It supports Ethereum and layer 2s natively, as well as Polkadot, Bitcoin and other chains.
wallet-gridplus-lattice1-description: The Lattice1 is a hardware wallet with a secure enclave, a touchscreen and human-readable contract data, so you can check what you are signing. Pair it with MetaMask, Frame and other wallets.
wallet-bitget-wallet-description: Bitget Wallet is a multi-chain wallet with swaps, staking, a dapp browser and an NFT marketplace. It supports seed-phrase, MPC keyless and smart account wallets.
wallet-blockwallet-description: BlockWallet is a self-custodial wallet for EVM networks built around ease of use and security.
wallet-onekey-description: OneKey makes an open-source wallet app and hardware wallets.
wallet-taho-description: Taho is a community-owned, open-source wallet governed by a DAO, for connecting to decentralized applications.
wallet-phantom-description: Phantom is a multi-chain wallet for DeFi and NFTs.
wallet-trust-wallet-description: Trust Wallet is a mobile and browser wallet that stores coins and tokens from many blockchains in one place.
wallet-shapeshift-description: ShapeShift is a community-owned, non-custodial multi-chain platform for trading, tracking and earning, with cross-chain trades between Ethereum, Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Litecoin and more.
wallet-gem-wallet-description: Gem Wallet is an open-source, self-custodial wallet for many blockchains, with built-in swaps, staking, name services and WalletConnect.
wallet-cypherock-x1-description: Cypherock X1 is an audited hardware wallet for crypto and NFTs. It can also back up existing BIP39-compatible wallets.
wallet-cake-wallet-description: Cake Wallet is a multi-crypto wallet focused on privacy tools, payments and cross-crypto swaps.
wallet-clear-wallet-description: Clear Wallet is a lightweight, open-source browser extension wallet for Ethereum.
wallet-braavos-description: Braavos is a smart contract wallet for Starknet with two- and three-factor authentication, a built-in token swap, human-readable transaction summaries and multicall.
wallet-coin98-super-wallet-description: Coin98 Super Wallet is a multi-chain wallet for EVM and non-EVM networks, with access to DeFi services.
wallet-burner-description: Burner is a low-cost NFC hardware wallet designed for gifting on Ethereum. Tap it with your phone to send and receive assets in the browser, with no app to install.
wallet-edge-wallet-description: Edge is a privacy-focused, self-custody mobile wallet for managing multiple cryptocurrencies across blockchains.
wallet-nufi-description: NuFi is a multi-chain wallet for Ethereum and EVM chains, Solana, Cardano and BNB Chain. It supports hardware wallets and offers social login for people new to crypto.
wallet-clave-description: Clave is a self-custodial smart wallet that uses passkeys, unified balances and cross-chain intents to make DeFi feel like a fintech app, with access to yields across DeFi.
wallet-uniswap-wallet-description: The Uniswap Wallet is a self-custody wallet from Uniswap Labs for swapping, sending, bridging and exploring apps across 15+ networks.
wallet-imkey-pro-hardware-wallet-descrip: imKey Pro is a hardware wallet from the imToken team for Bitcoin, Ethereum and more, with an EAL6+ secure chip. It works with imToken and Rabby.
wallet-infinex-wallet-crypto-superapp-de: Infinex is a passkey-based crypto app, mainly for EVM networks, that combines swaps, bridging, earning and perpetuals. The seed phrase is kept in a trusted execution environment, with no KYC.
